title: Comparatives and Superlatives
explanation: Short adjectives: add -er / -est (tall → taller → the tallest). Long adjectives: use more / the most (expensive → more expensive → the most expensive). Use than after comparatives: faster than me. Irregulars: good → better → the best, bad → worse → the worst.
explanationPersian: صفت‌های کوتاه er- و est- می‌گیرند و صفت‌های بلند با more و the most ساخته می‌شوند. بعد از صفت تفضیلی از than استفاده کنید. good و bad بی‌قاعده‌اند: better/best و worse/worst.

examples.english: My new phone is faster than my old one.
examples.persian: گوشی جدید من از قبلی سریع‌تر است.

examples.english: This is the most expensive restaurant in town.
Her English is better than mine.
examples.persian: انگلیسی او از من بهتر است.

examples.english: Today is the hottest day of the year.

exercises.prompt: This exercise is ___ than the last one.

exercises.explanation: Superlative of a short adjective: the highest.

exercises.incorrectSentence: This book is more better than that one.
acceptedAnswers: This book is better than that one.
exercises.explanation: Better is already comparative — never 'more better'.
exercises.explanationPersian: better خودش تفضیلی است؛ «more better» غلط است.

exercises.prompt: It was ___ movie I have ever seen.

exercises.explanation: Long adjective + than → more convenient than.
